## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified healthy release:** Checked the deployment history — the most recent version that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt partially failed with an orchestrator error (only us-east updated). I verified state and retried, which completed the rollout — all three regions are now on v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident:** INC-0001 documents the failure, the rollback actions (including the orchestrator partial failure), and follow-up items (root cause of the v2.3.1 health failures and the orchestrator error). The on-call engineer has been paged.
